title: Store Receiving, Free Hold, Storage and Abandonment Schedule for Ridgeline Special Order Services
content:
Once a Ridgeline Special Order Services item reaches the store, the program decides whether it is inspected on arrival and in how many days, how long it is held free once ready, what storage costs per day and in total, and when an item never collected is treated as abandoned.

## Terms of the schedule

- **Receipt inspection** — whether the store inspects the item on arrival before it is made ready.
- **Receipt inspection period** — calendar days after arrival within which the receipt inspection is recorded.
- **Free hold** — calendar days after the ready date the item is held free of charge.
- **Storage fee per day** — the storage fee per day after the free hold period, in US dollars; 0.00 means none.
- **Storage fee cap** — the largest total storage fee per order, in US dollars.
- **Abandonment period** — calendar days after the ready date after which an item not picked up or delivered is treated as abandoned.
- **Abandonment fee** — the fee on an abandoned order, as a percentage of the order total.

## Schedule

| Program | Receipt inspection | Inspection period (days) | Free hold (days) | Storage per day (USD) | Storage cap (USD) | Abandonment period (days) | Abandonment fee (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Catalog Merchandise | no | 1 | 14 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 30 | 15 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Cut-to-Order Flooring | no | 1 | 14 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 30 | 25 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Made-to-Measure Window Coverings | no | 1 | 14 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 30 | 100 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | yes | 2 | 30 | 5.00 | 150.00 | 60 | 25 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | yes | 2 | 30 | 10.00 | 300.00 | 60 | 25 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | yes | 2 | 30 | 10.00 | 300.00 | 60 | 50 |

## Reading the schedule

- Catalog Merchandise, Cut-to-Order Flooring and Made-to-Measure Window Coverings charge no storage: their storage fee per day is 0.00.
- Windows and Exterior Doors, Semi-Custom Cabinetry and Fabricated Countertops are inspected at store receipt within 2 days of arrival and are held free for 30 days after the ready date.
- For a hypothetical item that became ready on 10 January, an abandonment period of 30 days falls on 9 February and one of 60 days on 11 March (a year that is not a leap year).
